Capture is not enough: preserve the release-to-shot corridor
Measured old/C evidence plus one dimensioned concept. No new runtime source or dynamics. Units are model units, not CAD.
1 Receiver and support change together
Pivot remains |X|1.40 / Z4.45; same bat, keys and force.
First C arc retained to (1.6925, 3.55). Concept connector joins
accepted-relative terminal at (1.3793, 4.0284); neck min |X|1.3510.
Heel rail |X|1.435. New heel anchor Z4.65; no post at Z4.10.
Inner stock remains |X|1.35 / Z2.75..3.35; end support moves to3.10.
OUT has its own smooth tail to (1.865,4.35), not a folded offset.
2 Reserve, limits and next gates
Old traces shifted outward .15 are NOT predicted new trajectories.
At first Z3.35 crossing: |X| ~.430..1.138 (left); inner stock
sampled clearance >= +.069. Sling / full-world clearance not certified.
Compare all36, quiet capture u, released u range and both end contacts.
Keep the fixed C save frame only for causal diagnosis; moving save
and coil bracket remain a separate completion gate. No adoption.
Budget <=500,000 and reference long bands remain hard gates; independent index cleanup is not a shape change.
Reference is perspective artwork. The next outline is a design hypothesis, not a proven natural path or complete mechanism.
Sources: accepted c1; frozen C f956dcc1; saved36 departure analysis. Full dimensions, negative evidence and limits accompany this SVG.
